root_cause: TinyJS bridge.js lets a relaunched instance poll the previous single-instance pipe for only 5 s; the new instance then hands off to the old app and exits. If the old app's WebView2 shutdown takes longer, no app remains.

pre_fix_symptom.observed: first isolated updater install: install returned true and the new exe was in place, but 'relaunched instance did not appear' after 120 s
pre_fix_symptom.note: The swap itself had succeeded; this was a relaunch handoff failure, not an EBUSY.

isolated_race_probe.method: start app A, spawn launcher --spawn <exe> --tinyjs-relaunched, leave A alive for 9 s, then close A
isolated_race_probe.observed: B shell pid 16276 present at 1 s; absent at 9 s; A still alive; after closing A no B instance remained
isolated_race_probe.conclusion: 5 s pipe wait expires and B hands off/exits while A is still shutting down

fix: In main.js, before createApp's single-instance check, a --tinyjs-relaunched instance polls the same user-scoped app pipe for up to 30 s. It starts as soon as the pipe is free; stock handoff behavior and security are unchanged.

fixed_package_race.scenario: old instance kept alive 9s; new instance spawned with --tinyjs-relaunched
